defects_fixed.defect: A Windows junction reports neither isDirectory() nor isFile() and throws EISDIR on read, so the guard against excluded directories never applied and the mandatory test gate could not pass in this checkout.
defects_fixed.fix: Skip reparse points at the root cause instead of adding the local junction name to an exclusion set.
defects_fixed.verified: The gate passed with .codegraph present. A regression test creates a real junction and asserts the walk returns only ordinary files.

defects_fixed.defect: Node defaults test-file concurrency to every core. On this four-core host that oversubscribed the two Playwright-backed suites, whose tests carry a hard 20 s timeout, so the release gate failed on contention rather than behaviour and reported a cancelled test.
defects_fixed.fix: Bound test-file concurrency to at most two workers, reduced further on single-core hosts.
defects_fixed.verified: 284 tests, 281 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 3 expected Windows privilege skips.
